set.body:
Source: Q-08 local gap in the v1 evidence matrix.

Scope:
- Add a publishable observability module with pure redacted scheduler operation summaries and an effectful sink algebra.
- Wrap Scheduler[F] without changing its domain results or evidence authority.
- Bound sink delivery with a timeout; sink failure, timeout, or cancellation must not replace scheduler results.
- Record effect failure by class only, then re-raise the original effect failure.
- Exclude raw evidence, logs, environment values, script bytes, arguments, and credentials from telemetry types.

Acceptance:
- Submit/query/cancel outcomes classify without flattening domain failures.
- Slow or failing sinks cannot hang/fail a successful scheduler call.
- Scheduler effect failure remains an effect failure after best-effort recording.
- The wrapper owns no queue or durable state.
- Scala 3.7.4 v1 local gate passes.
set.title: P6e: Add bounded non-authoritative scheduler telemetry
